[[Chan the Dragon's Blood]] is an [[Am Fah]] [[boss]] that appears in [[The Undercity]]. He is often seen with a group of [[Canthan Peasant]]s. He is the [[Most Wanted Am Fah 2|second most wanted Am Fah]] by the [[Jade Brotherhood]] and is a distant, disowned relative of the emperor.

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|The Undercity}}

== Skills ==
15 [[Blood Magic]], 15 [[Curses]]
* {{skill icon|Blood is Power}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Enfeebling Blood}}
* {{skill icon|Life Siphon}}
* {{skill icon|Oppressive Gaze}}
* {{skill icon|Soul Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Vampiric Gaze}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Chan's Greed]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* If you go near him, he will walk all the way to the south-eastern corner of the Undercity, near [[Mina Shatter Storm]].
* He will not [[spawn]] after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her during [[Chasing Zenmai]].

== Trivia ==
* Chan the Dragon's Blood is briefly described on the [[Jade Brotherhood]]'s [[Most Wanted Am Fah 2|Most Wanted Am Fah #2]] plaque during the [[Deactivating P.O.X.]] [[quest]].
